title: Gates dock · где писать «1 landing»
intro: Claude Design, 17 Nov. Rule for every direction: the count column only holds the row's number (sessions, gates, graphs); the state (asks you, N to trust, N asking, N landing) moves to the label area. Attention (to trust, asks you) is an amber badge, moving (landing, asking) is plain caption ink.

A · After the label (designer's pick, your idea): «Gates · 1 landing  4». B · A pip on the glyph: numbers only, words on hover. C · A second line under the label that also names which gate: «1 landing · into main». Phone: the state goes into the row subtitle in every direction.

boards.title: Rule, A · B · C, pros and cons
boards.caption: The rule for all three dock rows, per-row states, the three directions, the phone, the handoff.

boards.title: A · After the label (recommended)
boards.caption: 1280 Mate dark and 640 Mate light: idle, 1 landing, 2 asking, attention on all three rows. Drawn with «·»; parentheses are the board's alternative.

boards.title: B · A pip on the glyph
boards.caption: Quietest; landing and asking look the same without a hover.

boards.title: C · A second line
boards.caption: Names the gate or graph; the pinned dock grows a line per active row, so the tree above jumps.

boards.title: Phone and iPad
boards.caption: The state leads the subtitle, the count stays on the right; attention fills the glyph amber.
